items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 14.04.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event itself is not counted, so the 30-day period starts on 15.04.2026. Counting 30 days forward (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) ends on 14.05.2026 (Thursday). 14.05.2026 is Christi Himmelfahrt, a nationwide public holiday, so under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Friday 15.05.2026.
